summary.intent: Plan and begin executing Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec Core Keystone) — a v2.0 architectural rewrite replacing legacy metadata types with unified Node types, dual-sealed bodies, and generation-based AAD, covering 9 plans across 7 waves.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (research, validation strategy, pattern mapping, plan-checker verification with 1 revision round, 100% coverage). Execution reached Wave 3 plan 62-04 (docs rewrite) with Waves 1–2 complete: 228/228 core tests green, node codec frozen with golden vectors, vault v3 blob hard-cut committed.

repo: The gsd commit helper can return `commit_failed` as a false negative — git log should be used to confirm the commit actually landed (happened with VALIDATION.md commit `2475ae35d`).
Worktree isolation is skipped in favor of sequential execution for this monorepo because worktrees lack node_modules and the 7-wave dependency chain (core→sdk-core→sdk→web) is simpler on one tree.
Phase 62 has a freeze-first constraint: node-codec.json golden vectors must be committed before any consumer seals, enforced by plan ordering (62-02 before waves 4+).
Consumer test files referencing deleted types fail tsc before `describe.skip` evaluates — imports must be removed, not just test bodies skipped (flagged by plan-checker as Warning 5).
The drift precheck non-blocking gate fires on nearly the entire repo when the codebase map is stale/missing, not when there are real Phase 62 drift issues.
API-surface intel regeneration returned 0 symbols for Phase 62 scope — the HINT file was omitted from the planner prompt as carrying no value.
The schema-gate contribution hook scans for ORM files; Phase 62 touches only packages/core crypto codec, not apps/api DB schema, so the gate silently skips.

Plan 08 was split into 08a (web logic, wave 6) and 08b (web components + final root pnpm typecheck, wave 7) because ~43 files exceeded the single-plan threshold and risked context exhaustion in autonomous execution.
Pattern mapper found 13/14 analogs — key templates: folder/metadata.ts codec, crypto/seal.ts primitive, vault/blob.ts v3, vault-blob-vectors.test.ts golden vectors.
PATTERNS.md committed by the orchestrator explicitly because step 13d only commits PLAN/STATE/ROADMAP — a known gap in the workflow.

code.finding: New unified Node types created in Wave 1 (62-01): Node, SealedChildRef, PublishedNode, content/write-body types — foundation for the entire codec.
sealNode/unsealNode composes the Phase-61 sealAesGcmAad/buildNodeAad primitive — created in Wave 2 (62-02), must exist before any consumer seals.
Frozen golden vectors: body-bytes primary lock (IV-independent) + fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock. Reuses Phase-61 node_id/IV so Phase-69 Rust test slots in directly.

Cross-language vector for vault v3 blob (two-key layout: 0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey)). Moved from inline plan to committed file per plan-checker Warning 2.

workflow: The plan-checker gate is worth running even on tightly-specified phases — it caught 1 blocker (missing RESOLVED markers in RESEARCH.md) and 4 correctness-consequential warnings in one pass.
Nyquist validation requires RESEARCH.md to have a `## Validation Architecture` section; without it, plans lack Dimension-8 validation requirements and VALIDATION.md cannot be generated.
Exit-code masking via trailing `echo` in partial-tsc verify steps is a correctness issue — robust gates require explicit exit-code capture, especially for unsupervised autonomous execution.

auto_advance=true in config would normally chain into execute-phase automatically; for keystone phases touching ~30 consumer files, stopping at 'planned' status before autonomous execution is the safer default.
The --no-transition flag stops the phase chain after Phase 62 completes rather than auto-advancing to Phase 63 — important for AFK execution of high-blast-radius phases.
Wave-level integration gates (full core test suite after Wave 2) are valuable checkpoints before structural cutover waves — locks in a green baseline before consumer files are touched.

friction: gsd commit helper returned `commit_failed` false-negative for VALIDATION.md despite the commit landing cleanly — required manual git log verification.
Bash node eval had a quoting bug when parsing worktree/degrade config, requiring a re-extraction pass.
Requirements-coverage display had a word-splitting glitch printing all six NODE IDs as one token — required a clean rerun to produce a trustworthy result.
ROADMAP wave annotation was idempotent (updated: false) because the revision subagent had already set wave structure — the orchestrator's annotation step was a no-op, slightly confusing.
The `feat/unified-node-codec-core-keystone` branch was already current, making the branching_strategy=phase init slightly redundant to parse.
API-surface intel hook ran but returned 0 symbols, adding latency with no planning value for this phase.
open_items: Wave 3 plan 62-04 (METADATA_SCHEMAS.md docs rewrite) was in progress when the transcript ended — execution incomplete.
Plans 62-05 through 62-08b (waves 3–7: core barrel cutover, sdk-core/sdk/web compile-gates, web component quarantine, final root pnpm typecheck) are all pending.
Phase-69 Rust golden vector test needs to slot into node-codec.json using the frozen node_id/IV — cross-language parity is deferred to Phase 69.
~30 consumer files in sdk-core, sdk, web need stub behavior replaced with real implementations in their owning phases (65 for write-chain/share/bin/invite, others TBD).
The codebase map is stale (drift gate flagged 143 pre-existing elements) — /gsd-map-codebase should be run to refresh the baseline, though it was non-blocking for Phase 62.
PATTERNS.md commit gap in step 13d (only commits PLAN/STATE/ROADMAP) — the orchestrator worked around it manually but the workflow has a known gap worth fixing.
phase uat-passed command has no handler (per existing memory) — remains unimplemented.
